state.seed_assertion: Loose or contaminated connectors, soldering defects, and wire crimping issues are among the most common causes of intermittent faults.

sentences.1: Loose or contaminated connectors, soldering defects, and wire crimping issues are among the most common causes of intermittent faults.
sentences.2: Interconnections at various levels are the most common cause of the faults I see: loose or contaminated connectors, soldering, wire crimping, etc.
sentences.3: Physical stress testing on cabling and connectors, vibration testing, and thermal cycling can reveal wiring and soldering issues.
sentences.4: Physical stress on cabling and connectors as well as vibration and thermal cycling (heat gun and freeze spray) can often chase out wiring and soldering issues.
sentences.5: Loose conductors, damaged flex cables and marginal sensors can produce pulses too short to notice on an HMI.
sentences.6: Loose conductors, damaged flex cables and marginal sensors can produce pulses too short to notice on an HMI.
sentences.7: Loose terminals and oxidized connections create jitter that a PLC processor might interpret as a false state, undermining signal integrity.
sentences.8: Loose terminals and oxidized connections are silent killers of signal integrity.
sentences.9: Loose connections create random failures from vibration.
